name: 7-acetoxymitragynine
summary: 7-Acetoxymitragynine is an opioid drug which is a semi-synthetic derivative of 7-hydroxymitragynine, a natural product derived from the South-East Asian tree known as kratom. It can be derived by acetylation of the hydroxyl group of 7-hydroxymitragynine, for instance with acetic anhydride, but can also be produced directly from mitragynine by reaction with Lead(IV) acetate.
summaryZh: 7-乙醯氧基帽柱木鹼（英語：7-Acetoxymitragynine）是一種有機化合物，分子式C25H32N2O6，為卡痛樹中的生物鹼7-羥基帽柱木鹼的半合成衍生物，可由其與乙酸酐合成。
